verdict.rationale: Authy's features page documents app-level access protection via TouchID, PIN and passwords for the 2FA tokens. A hands-on user independently confirms using Face ID to protect the entire app on their phone, which directly addresses the borrowed-phone scenario. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on lock behavior (auto-lock timing, Face ID/Android biometric specifics, fallback options).

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes

citations.quote: Use TouchID, PIN protection and passwords to protect access to your 2FA tokens.
I use Authy with Face ID protecting the entire app on my phone
